## Study title

Levaraging a genetic proxy to study the lifelong affects of adrenergic receptor blockers.

Alternative title: Studying the effects of DBH deficiency in Finngen

## Figures

Forest plot

```{r}
##12072024
#forest plot
library(readr)
library(forestploter)
alpha <- read.delim("C:/Users/lifyeo/rrsnps/disease-cox.txt")
#alpha$'' <- cut(alpha$'P', breaks=c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), label=c("***", "**", "*", "")) 
alpha
alpha$` ` <- paste(rep(" ", 30), collapse = " ")

# Create a confidence interval column to display
alpha$`HR (95% CI)` <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)",
                          alpha$HR, alpha$lower95, alpha$upper95)
alpha

#make the words center
tm <- forest_theme(base_size = 18,
                   rowhead=list(fg_params=list(hjust=0, x=0)),
                   colhead=list(fg_params=list(hjust=0.5, x=0.5)),
                  #core=list(fg_params=list(hjust=0.5, x=0.5)),
                   ci_Theight = 0.3,
                   ci_lwd = 2)

alpha_ft <- forest(alpha[,c(1:2, 9,8, 6:7)],
                est = alpha$HR,
                lower = alpha$lower95, 
                upper = alpha$upper95,
                #sizes = alpha$se,
                ci_column = 4,
                ref_line = 1,
                xlim = c(0,2),
                ticks_at = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2),
                #x_trans = c("log10"),
                xlab = "Hazard ratio",
                theme = tm)

# Print plot
plot(alpha_ft)

# Save plots to PDF, specifying dimensions
pdf("diseaseCox.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)
print(alpha_ft)
dev.off()
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
alpha <- read.delim("C:/Users/lifyeo/rrsnps/drug-hutan.txt")
alpha
alpha$` ` <- paste(rep(" ", 30), collapse = " ")

# Create a confidence interval column to display
alpha$`HR (95% CI)` <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)",
                          alpha$HR, alpha$lower95, alpha$upper95)
alpha

#make the words center
tm <- forest_theme(base_size = 18,
                   rowhead=list(fg_params=list(hjust=0, x=0)),
                   colhead=list(fg_params=list(hjust=0.5, x=0.5)),
                  #core=list(fg_params=list(hjust=0.5, x=0.5)),
                   ci_Theight = 0.3,
                   ci_lwd = 2)

alpha_ft <- forest(alpha[,c(1:2, 9,8, 6:7)],
                est = alpha$HR,
                lower = alpha$lower95, 
                upper = alpha$upper95,
                #sizes = alpha$se,
                ci_column = 4,
                #ref_line = 1,
                xlim = c(0.4, 1),
                ticks_at = c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0),
                #x_trans = c("log10"),
                xlab = "Hazard ratio",
                theme = tm)

# Print plot
plot(alpha_ft)

# Save plots to PDF, specifying dimensions
pdf("drugCox.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)
print(alpha_ft)
dev.off()
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
